outcomes: Actual paid entry reveals the entire opponent hand publicly before filtering; choice of a nonland is optional and controlled by the frozen packet controller. Decline, all-land hand and prevented exile create no link or token. Wrong actor/owner/land choices reject transactionally.

Only successful exact new exile incarnations are linked to the exact source incarnation and acquired ability origin. Source departure before ETB resolution does not stop later reveal/exile, but its earlier LTB cannot retroactively create a token. Blink, stale exile and a new copied ability pair cannot use the old links.

At LTB resolution, only cards still in exile for this linked pair contribute. Copied ETBs sum all linked mana values under607.3; a single owner gets one token of the sum, and each distinct owner gets one token of that full sum. Copied LTB packets can create again because resolving one does not consume the links. Official Skyclave notes explicitly support this multiowner behavior.

The exiled cards owner creates each white Spirit, regardless of current source/ability controller. Each owner receives their own token replacements in APNAP order; processed batches remain owned until a single simultaneous entry commit. A0MV link still creates0/0 tokens, observed by entry triggers before SBA.
Owned optional hand choice and pending second-owner token replacement replay identically through raw/index/restore after parent disposal, preserving independent decline and correct owners.

Actual combat damage in both seats captures its recipient and actual positive amount. Noncombat, zero and prevented damage do not trigger. A legal reflected hit on the source controller uses that players library rather than assuming the opponent. Source departure and later counters do not change the frozen quantity.
The fullu128 quantity bounds the finite library before address-size conversion. Exact successful new exile incarnations form the one immediate offer; a short library exiles all available.

Each spell independently has mana value<=X. Existing exclusive maximum storesX+1 when representable; at/aboveu64MAX the bound is absent because all represented card mana values qualify. There is no cumulative mana-value budget or spell count quota. Two2MV spells both cast free after2damage.

Lands and spells aboveX reject transactionally. The source may leave, freeX is0, and mandatory additional costs remain required and actually paid. Choosing finish leaves uncast cards in exile without a later permission.
The immediate offer survives owned raw/index/restore and parent disposal, with a sibling that declines independently.
